title: What if dads had to sit on the egg? (the emperor penguin challenge)
description:
Emperor penguin dads balance an egg on their feet through the Antarctic winter, for about two months, without eating. How do they survive, and what if human dads had to do it?
Bix visits the coldest daycare on Earth: brood pouches, 20-degree penguin huddles, "penguin milk", and what fatherhood really does to human dads.

Chapters:
0:00 The coldest dad job
0:16 Meet the emperor
0:33 Why winter?
0:55 The hand-off
1:10 The brood pouch
1:37 The penguin sauna
2:11 Penguin dad milk
2:31 What if human dads had to do it?
3:12 Human dads change too
3:36 Back in the lab
